notablePrerequisites: You have at least three additional cards between your graveyard and/or hand.
description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast False Memories from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {1}{U} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill seven cards.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Repeat.
